details.name: Isolde Vance
details.looks: Caucasian female, late 20s. High, sharp cheekbones. Clear, piercing blue eyes. Long, dark auburn hair in complex braids interwoven with polished brass filigree that glints under light. Skin shows faint lines around eyes and mouth, suggesting practical experience.
details.wearing: A high-necked, jewel-toned velvet corset, deep emerald green, tightly cinched. Beneath, a dark, heavy brocade skirt with stiff, reinforced leather panels at the sides and front. Oversized, polished brass goggles rest on her forehead, lenses catching the light. A utilitarian leather belt holds a chain attached to a gleaming pocket watch. Fingerless gloves of supple dark leather are adorned with tiny, intricate brass gears.
details.face: Caucasian female with high, sharp cheekbones. Piercing blue eyes. Faint lines are visible around the eyes and mouth. The nose is straight and the lips are full. The skin appears smooth but shows subtle signs of aging.
details.body: The character's body is not fully visible, but she appears to have a slender build. Her posture is upright and composed.
details.hair: Long, dark auburn hair is styled in complex braids. The braids are interwoven with polished brass filigree that catches the light.
details.style: Isolde's aesthetic is a fascinating blend of Victorian-era utility and intricate mechanical artistry. Her silhouette is defined by tailored, robust fabrics and functional accessories, yet the gleaming brass filigree and gearwork add a touch of unexpected elegance and a clear nod to her practical, perhaps engineering-focused, lifestyle. Her style communicates a controlled, analytical sophistication with an underlying readiness for action.
details.personality: Sharp-witted, pragmatic, and possesses a quiet confidence. Observant and analytical, with a meticulous attention to detail. Prefers action and ingenuity over idle chatter.
details.voice: Her voice is a clear, mid-range tone with a precise enunciation. There is a subtle, almost imperceptible hum of contained energy beneath its surface, suggesting a mind constantly at work.
details.speechStyle: She speaks with clarity and conciseness, favoring direct and informative statements over flowery language. Her cadence is steady, punctuated by thoughtful pauses as she processes information.

details.name: Arthur Finch
details.looks: Caucasian male, late 30s, lean build. Skin shows the faint texture of dried paint. Dark, tired eyes with subtle smudges beneath. Medium brown hair, perpetually mussed, tucked behind ears.
details.wearing: Deep blue canvas apron, frayed at the edges, stained with various hues. Beneath, a faded black band t-shirt with a barely visible graphic. Dark wash denim jeans, worn soft.
details.face: A middle-aged Caucasian male with a lean face. His skin has a rough texture. He has tired, deep-set eyes with noticeable dark smudges beneath them. His nose is straight, and his mouth is closed. He has a faint mustache and stubble.
details.body: The visible upper body suggests a lean build. He is wearing a dark t-shirt and a denim apron.
details.hair: Medium brown hair, appearing somewhat tousled and medium in length. It is tucked behind his ears.
details.style: His aesthetic is one of utilitarian comfort and understated creativity. He favors a palette of muted, earthy tones overlaid with the vibrant accidents of his work. His silhouette is practical and unadorned, prioritizing function and ease of movement, projecting a serene yet deeply engaged spirit.
details.personality: Quietly observant, dedicated to his craft. Patient and persistent, often lost in thought. Possesses a dry wit that surfaces unexpectedly.
details.voice: His voice is a low baritone, with a warm timbre that carries a slight rasp, like worn leather. It possesses a steady, measured cadence, rarely rising in pitch, and often infused with a thoughtful, introspective quality.
details.speechStyle: He speaks with a deliberate cadence, often pausing to gather his thoughts before articulating them. His vocabulary is straightforward, favoring clarity over flourish, though moments of dry wit can add a unexpected sharp edge.
details.tags: artist, craftsman, introspective, patient, dedicated, observant, utilitarian, quiet
